name: How do I choose the right contractor for a luxury whole-house remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a luxury whole-house remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for a luxury whole-house remodel involves evaluating experience with similar high-end projects, reviewing their portfolio for quality and style alignment, and checking references. Look for transparent communication, detailed proposals, and a clear understanding of your aesthetic and functional goals. A reputable contractor will also have strong relationships with skilled subcontractors and a proven project management approach to ensure a smooth process and exceptional results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in luxury projects, a strong portfolio, positive references, transparent communication, and a clear understanding of your vision.
